notes: The husband/father (~30) died in 2005. Zadośćuczynienie under art. 448 in connection with art. 24 k.c. (death before 3.08.2008); for the widow, the first instance used art. 445 (depression leading to the loss of her unborn child), and the appeal criticised that basis but kept the amount.
